title: Jack Henry falls victim to ransomware attack
summary: US core banking vendor Jack Henrry has been bit by a ransomware attack.
content: US core banking vendor Jack Henry has become the victim of a ransomware attack, according to recent reports. The incident highlights ongoing cybersecurity risks facing financial technology providers and institutions. Investigations are currently underway to determine the extent of the breach and any potential impact on sensitive data or system operations.

title: Félix raises $200m in equity and debt to expand beyond remittances
summary: Félix, a chat-based platform that utilises WhatsApp to enable Latino immigrants in the US to send money abroad, is planning to add a host of other financial products after raising $87 million in a Series C equity round.
content: Félix has raised funding in a new round to expand its operations. The chat-based platform, which operates using WhatsApp to help Latino immigrants in the United States send money abroad, plans to introduce a variety of additional financial products following the successful financing event.
